archetypes.name: sidecar-contract
archetypes.rationale: The plan's inner-sentinel retry and sidecar-promotion sequence depend on specific library functions (codex_launcher_promote_inner_done, RUN_EXTERNAL_AGENT_INNER_SENTINEL_SUFFIX, preflight bundle shape) that must match what lib-external-launcher-common.sh, run-external-agent.sh, and collect-agent-results.sh actually export and poll — a mismatch would stall or mis-classify background lanes silently.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify every sidecar artifact the plan specifies (.done, .inner.done, .meta, .diag, .events.jsonl, .sidecar) against the polling and promotion contracts in scripts/lib-external-launcher-common.sh, scripts/run-external-agent.sh, and scripts/collect-agent-results.sh. Check that codex_launcher_promote_inner_done, RUN_EXTERNAL_AGENT_INNER_SENTINEL_SUFFIX, and codex_launcher_record_usage_from_events are exported with the signatures the plan assumes. Verify the preflight failure bundle shape (truncate output, .diag STATUS=FAILED, stub .meta CMD_JSON=[], .done, emit_kv LAUNCHER_EXIT, exit 0) matches the launch-review.sh:444-463 pattern the plan cites. Flag any function names, env-var names, or artifact names in the plan that differ from what the source files actually define. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: exit-grammar
archetypes.rationale: The plan introduces a split exit model (launcher always-exits-0 with stdout LAUNCHER_EXIT for background callers; exit 2 for argv/auth errors in negotiation and path-validation) — a cross-site contract that must match how lint-fix-loop.sh, run-negotiation-round.sh callers, and background fence collectors currently branch on exit codes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace every exit path in the plan and verify it against the current callers in the repo. For launch-codex-exec.sh, confirm that lint-fix-loop.sh's run_codex() currently branches on the wrapper shell exit code and that the plan's stdout-parse replacement is complete and consistent. For run-negotiation-round.sh, check that its current callers handle exit 2 for auth failure versus prior exit behavior. For validate_meta_scalar_path exit 2, confirm the plan's argv-error classification (no .done written) matches how other launchers treat validation failures. Identify any caller that would silently swallow a failure due to the always-exit-0 wrapper contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: lint-scope
archetypes.rationale: The new lint-codex-exec-auth.sh must cover the right file set with a pragma format consistent with lint-bare-grep-probe.sh and must not immediately break CI against existing codex exec call sites that need pragmas — gaps here would either miss violations or block the PR from landing on first make lint.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the proposed linter's scope rules (include patterns scripts/*.sh, skills/*/scripts/*.sh, markdown fence scan) and exclusion patterns (test-*.sh, larch-logs/) against scripts/lint-bare-grep-probe.sh for consistency in walk logic, pragma format, and git-ls-files vs. find-walk parity. Search the repo for all existing codex exec invocations in shell and markdown that fall within the proposed scope and verify the plan either adds pragmas to each or routes them through launch-codex-exec.sh — any missed site causes CI to fail on first make lint after merge. Check whether the covered-launchers list (launch-review.sh, launch-codex-ci.sh, launch-codex-implement.sh, check-reviewers.sh, review-and-fix.sh) is handled by pragma suppression or scope exclusion in the plan, and whether the plan is explicit about which mechanism applies. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
